Method.Description: Reduction of result.get_ss() and net.get_sys: 'Kron' (eliminate the bus voltages), 'Feedback' (bus models connected through the admittance matrix) or 'DAE' (descriptor form)

Coordinate.Description: Bus variables of the 'DAE' reduction: 'theta&rho' (angle and log magnitude), 'theta&V' (angle and magnitude) or 'Vre&Vim' (real and imaginary parts)

PlotFcn.Description: Live display during the analysis ('none'; other displays are under development). The figure after the analysis: result.plot_eigenvalue()
